review_comment: The expression '_self.config.highlight || true' always evaluates to true, overriding user configuration for the highlight feature. This prevents administrators from disabling client-side syntax highlighting even when they configure it to be off. Fix by removing the '|| true' to ensure the highlight setting properly reflects user security preferences.

The default html:false configuration prevents raw HTML in markdown rendering, but this control can be bypassed if administrators change the setting. Ensure that markdown rendering always applies HTML encoding regardless of configuration, or implement additional sanitization after parsing to prevent XSS when html mode is enabled.

The markdownify function renders user-controlled markdown to HTML without sanitization when the html option is enabled. If HTML rendering is permitted, script elements in markdown could generate unsafe HTML output. Add HTML sanitization after parser.render() to strip script tags and dangerous attributes, or ensure the html option remains disabled by default with clear warnings about security implications.

The parser initialization allows HTML rendering to be enabled via admin configuration. When html:true is set, user post content could render as raw HTML without demonstrated neutralization. Ensure HTML rendering is either disabled or that proper input sanitization is implemented when enabled. Consider maintaining html:false as the only safe configuration or implementing strict content security policies.
